reader_summary.headline: My guest this week is Auren Hoffman.
reader_summary.overview: My guest this week is Auren Hoffman. Auren is the CEO of Safegraph, which curates data on physical locations. He also founded LiveRamp, a public data connectivity business. Auren knows more about data businesses than almost anyone I know and that is the topic of today’s discussion.

key_points.text: We look at the business of data from every angle and finish with a fun masterclass on how to host a dinner party.
Please enjoy my conversation with Auren Hoffman.
